description: Scott Perry is the Representative for Pennsylvania’s 10th Congressional District, bringing a diverse background in business, military, and community service to the U.S. House of Representatives. Initially a Pennsylvania State Representative, Perry has served in Congress since 2013, transitioning to the 10th District in 2018. He serves on the Transportation & Infrastructure, Foreign Affairs, and Oversight & Accountability Committees and previously chaired the House Freedom Caucus.
